title: Peter Neumann has died
summary: This is an obituary announcement for Peter Neumann, a pioneering computer security researcher who made significant contributions to cybersecurity, Unix history, and was known for his prescient warnings about internet security vulnerabilities. He was a chief computer scientist at SRI International and a founding member of the ARPA Computer Security Group.
problem_solved: This post is not a technical solution but rather a memorial notice announcing the passing of a major figure in computer security history.
why_valuable: Peter Neumann's death marks the loss of one of computing's most influential security pioneers who foresaw many cybersecurity challenges decades before they became mainstream concerns.
